verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own Exports API: you pick an export type and a date range, covering customers, customer screening, screening and monitoring cases, profiles, payment screening cases, transaction monitoring cases and alerts, and transactions. It also documents CSV export of transaction data for use outside the platform, and the API case audit trail offers another route to case history. However, an open format (CSV) is only documented for transactions, and nothing evidences a complete full-account export or an exit path. missing for 10: documented open file formats for every export type, evidence that exports cover all data (e.g. configurations, risk-scoring settings, audit logs), account offboarding or deletion process, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
